weapons.name: Pumpkin Mortar
weapons.desc: Fires a hollowed-out pumpkin full of burning wax. Very seasonal.

weapons.name: Banshee Wail
weapons.desc: A shriek on every frequency. Locks a system and freezes the crew in the room.

augments.name: Lucky Black Cat
augments.desc: Not unlucky at all, for you: +5% evasion.

races.name: Wisp
races.desc: Drifting will-o'-the-wisps. Fragile, quick, need no air and cannot burn.

sectors.name: The Hollow Nebula
sectors.blurb: Orange fog, flickering lights and ships nobody remembers launching. Trick or treat.
intro: Every beacon here has a carved pumpkin floating next to it. Nobody knows who puts them there.
The Hollow Nebula. Your crew insist they heard someone laughing in the vents.

events.text: A small ship covered in paper bats pulls up. Its crew, all wearing sheets with eye holes, shout: "Trick or treat!"

effect.text: They squeal with delight and leave you a bowl of something sugary.

success.text: Their trick is to wash your hull. It looks great.

fail.text: Their trick is to egg your sensors.

choices.text: Turn off the lights and pretend nobody's home.

effect.text: They knock for a while, then leave.

events.text: A pale light dances outside the canopy, bobbing as if it wants you to follow.

success.text: It leads you to a forgotten cache, then flits aboard and refuses to leave.

fail.text: It leads you straight into an asteroid. It seems very pleased with itself.

effect.text: It sulks off into the fog.

events.text: A black cat is sitting on your airlock. In space. It looks at you as if you are late.

effect.text: It walks straight to the captain's chair and sits in it. Your evasion improves for no reason anyone can explain.
It blinks, and is gone. So is one of your fuel cells.

events.text: A graveyard of ships, each hull carved with a name. One of them is the name of your ship.

success.text: It's a different ship with the same name, and a hold full of salvage.

fail.text: Something in the wreck wakes up.

events.text: A drifting farm habitat grows pumpkins the size of shuttles. The farmer offers you one, "for the fireworks".

choices.text: Take a pumpkin launcher instead (35 scrap).

effect.text: The farmer's nephew built it. It mostly works.
Back-breaking work, but good food and a fair wage.
